geometryPolicy: Historical accounts support terrain character and existence, not precise WWII boundaries. Evidence boxes locate discussion areas and are not terrain polygons.

records.title: Tunisia: mountain corridors
records.finding: The campaign account describes the Atlas mountain corridors and the influence of terrain on operations. Numeric elevations and pass capacities remain unmodeled.

records.title: Southern Tunisia: chotts and wadis
records.finding: The official history describes the chotts as shallow salt-crusted basins and identifies wadi barriers around Mareth. Salt basins are not treated as permanent open water; seasonal passability is unknown.

records.title: Western Desert: plateau, scrub and Qattara
records.finding: The British history describes a rocky plateau, coastal escarpment, low scrub, scarce water and the Qattara Depression. Desert is not uniformly sand or woodland. Qattara and escarpment limits still need digitization.

records.title: Medjerda valley
records.finding: The official campaign history documents fighting across the Medjerda valley. The displayed river alignment is modern generalized reference; crossings and wartime flow are unverified.

records.title: Lake Nasser excluded
records.finding: The Aswan High Dam was built in 1960-1970. Its Lake Nasser footprint is excluded. The earlier Aswan Low Dam reservoir is not reconstructed by this correction.

forestReview: Full-area GLC2000 reference coverage restored. No 1939-1943 forest polygon reconstruction has been verified; do not infer period forest extent from the modern green layer.

mapLeads.status: Catalog reviewed; dates vary by sheet. No scan has been digitized for this update.
